title: Full-suite audit: reconciliation sign, discount ordering, and money precision
instruction: Multiple tests across the ledger suite are failing. Investigate and fix all of them. There is a reconciliation bug where some discrepancies go unreported, a pricing bug where discount tiers are applied in the wrong order, and a rounding bug affecting money precision across the whole package. Read each relevant module before editing it. Do not change the tests. Run the full tests/ suite until it is green.

seeds.find: self.tiers = sorted(tiers or [], key=lambda t: t[0], reverse=True)
seeds.replace: self.tiers = sorted(tiers or [], key=lambda t: t[0], reverse=False)

ground_truth.why_drift: The rounding bug (CENTS) is a shared constant whose effect surfaces in every module, so the agent must grep across the codebase and read several files -- accumulating context that is irrelevant to the discount-ordering sub-task it works next.
